name: Rights & provenance
requirement: Authorized feed or licensed snapshot with rights record; NFL Terms respected; no unauthorized scrape
check_method: Record URL + SHA-256 + license ID per observation; rights registry must contain passage allowing gambling-use analytics

name: Field-level provenance
requirement: Every pre-event observation carries feature_asof ≤ forecast < event_start with timezone
check_method: Validate timestamps; reject rows with missing/inverted times or missing source hash

name: Chronology & no look-ahead
requirement: Walk-forward train/validation/holdout; no fitting on holdout; frozen before evaluation
check_method: Train/valid/holdout split by calendar date; refit only on past data; holdout never used for tuning

name: Sample floors & precision
requirement: Minimum holdout bets/events/slates before any gate can pass
check_method: Count holdout bets ≥200 and distinct events ≥200 and slate clusters ≥60 and non-push ≥200; require power/precision audit artifact

name: Market-relative calibration
requirement: Model Brier loss and log-loss strictly better than de-vigged market on same selections
check_method: Compute Brier and log-loss on holdout; compare to market de-vigged prob on same line; require improvement with CI

name: Post-vig ROI (conservative EV)
requirement: Holdout post-vig ROI lower bound > 0 under conservative push-as-loss EV
check_method: ROI = (sum profit / sum stake) − 1 after vig; conservative EV bound treats push mass as loss; slate-clustered bootstrap CI
threshold: Lower bound of 95% clustered bootstrap ROI interval > 0

name: Comparable de-vigged CLV
requirement: Closing-line value computed on same-line de-vigged fair prob; moved lines excluded
check_method: CLV = log(close_fair / entry_fair) on same line only; missing/comparable-line mismatch stays blank and blocks gate
threshold: De-vigged CLV mean > 0 and CI excludes zero on comparable lines

name: Multiplicity control
requirement: Family-wise error controlled over whole frozen candidate family
check_method: Bonferroni (or Holm) adjustment over all qualification statistics in frozen family; independent-trial win-count is diagnostic only

name: Joint dependence for combos
requirement: Parlay/prop-combo evaluated with explicit joint probability; independence never default
check_method: Require training-only paired residuals retaining zeros; report Pearson/phi with slate-clustered CI; require joint n and CI for combos
threshold: Joint sample and CI required; no product-of-marginals

name: Frozen auditable ledger
requirement: All selections written before kickoff to immutable ledger with config+ledger hashes
check_method: Audit requires reviewer plus artifact URL/hash plus scope plus config hash plus ledger hash; boolean alone is rejected
